title: The Fall of Wrath
dek: The company reaches the Citadel of Sorrow, crosses its wards, and kills Wrath. Elenia falls during the victory, and the work of keeping Gael begins amid grief.

body:
The final assault comes after losses on the road through Gael. The surviving company reaches the Citadel of Sorrow tired and grieving. Lava has swept over the earlier battlefield. The fortress still stands between them and Wrath.

The gates and the wards

The gates open onto defenders rather than directly onto the knight. A nightmare-like guardsman threatens the company, and a dragon flies forward as the fighting begins. The survivors overcome the gate’s defenders while another pursuer draws nearer behind them.

Inside, the citadel is quiet and heavily trapped. Pulsing crystals guard the way. Investigation shows that they must be fed magical energy, although the travelers cannot establish every consequence of passing one unsatisfied. Gartina feeds one from her wand; Dale gives charges from a ring to the next.

A room of interlocking runes presents another obstacle. Wren investigates while Quake crosses toward the skulls at the back. Together they find a mechanism that turns part of the floor and scrambles the runes. Beyond it, a blood-marked passage brings a danger aimed at the travelers’ beliefs as well as their bodies. The company keeps moving through the fortress rather than meeting Wrath with all its strength untouched.

Words before the last battle

Wrath says he is preparing himself to die and hopes for a worthy end. Elenia tries to turn the conversation toward life and his lost love, Endora. He insists that he has cared, perhaps too much, and claims that Death promised him reunion with her.

Elenia asks to help Endora and to be shown the truth without swords. Wrath refuses to resolve the confrontation that way. His account of his bargain remains his account; understanding the grief beneath his violence does not stop the battle.

Offers made while companions fall

Arjahn offers himself. Wren also tries to bargain for the others’ lives, offering service in exchange for their freedom. Scribonia warns that joining Death would merely postpone the cost and turn it against more people. The company is still arguing about what can be saved while it fights.

Wrath strikes Elenia and cleaves her body in two. Her companions see the blow. Her loss is part of the victory’s price, not a distant event added after the battle is already won.

Draygar, wounded and furious, continues striking. Saray answers the accumulating deaths with another shot. She lands the final blow. The knight sinks to his knees and his remaining summoned strength fails around him.

Roderick on the floor

Dumuzi comes through the doorway and cradles the fallen Roderick. The scene makes the person beneath Wrath visible in the immediate aftermath of the fight. It does not erase his choices or the people he has killed.

Death offers an explanation of himself and the end he promises. His words are a proposal made to exhausted survivors, not an objective ruling that their resistance has been mistaken. They continue to question him rather than receiving a final answer to the war.

Gartina runs to Elenia’s remains and gathers them into her bag of holding. Dale strikes Wrath’s corpse and demands that she be given back. Others stand ready in case the surviving enemies move. Victory has not made the company calm or whole.

Bringing Elenia back

Gartina’s Reincarnate in the Sanctum of the Wise belongs to the battle’s immediate aftermath. The companions accept that Elenia may look different before the result is known. Her return is a separate act of care and magic after the fatal blow; Wrath’s defeat does not undo the death by itself.

The recovered Sanctum account supports that return. It remains distinct from Nienna’s earlier deaths and resurrections and from the other losses suffered during the long campaign.

Gael after the knight

The later record describes Wrath as defeated while warning that Gael remains dangerous. Stragglers and the region’s other hazards survive him. Roads, settlement and restoration still require work.

Huoth continues guiding the living; the planted and restored ground must be kept. The later community inherits an opening created by the assault, rather than an island made instantly safe. The fall of Wrath changes the war, but the people who survive it must still decide how to live in the land they have fought to reach.

People and places in this history Gael · Gael · the war and the keeping · Roderick / Wrath · Saray · Elenia · Gartina · Huoth, Emissary of Nuru
